title: Inspiratory Effort in COVID-19
official: Inspiratory Effort Assessment in Patients With COVID-19 Pneumonia Undergoing Non Invasive Respiratory Support
summary: This study aims at assessing esophageal pressure in patients with acute respiratory failure due to COVID-19 undergoing non invasive respiratory support.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* COVID-19
* Acute respiratory failure undergoing non-invasive respiratory support

Exclusion Criteria:

* Need for immediate endotracheal intubation
* Chronic respiratory diseases
sponsor: University of Modena and Reggio Emilia
